boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Emmanuel College study settings, from reservable rooms and technology-equipped spaces to atriums suited to solo or collaborative work.

cards.title: Settle Into the Cardinal Cushing Library
cards.subtitle: Carrels, tables, computers and research help in one study hub
cards.notes: Choose a carrel for individual work or a table for collaboration; check the library calendar before planning a long session.
cards.short_summary: A sunlit library combining individual carrels, collaborative tables, computer stations and staff research assistance.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel states that the library provides extensive study and collaboration space, including group rooms, individual carrels and computer stations.
cards.source_title: Cardinal Cushing Library at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: Consult the official Library Calendar for current operating hours; finals may have extended hours.

cards.entity_name: Library Learning Commons Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Book a Learning Commons Group Room
cards.subtitle: Reservable library rooms for teams of two to four
cards.notes: Reserve through the Student Resources area of MySaints up to two weeks ahead, then keep the session within the posted two-hour limit.
cards.short_summary: A defined library option for small groups that need a reservable room rather than open collaborative seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The college says Learning Commons group study spaces can be booked up to two weeks ahead for groups of two to four and are limited to two hours daily.
cards.source_title: Study Spots & Library at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: Emmanuel students reserve through MySaints; rooms serve groups of two to four for up to two hours per day.

cards.title: Pair Study Time With ARC Support
cards.subtitle: Ground-floor workspace with tutoring, coaching and specialists nearby
cards.notes: Bring a specific assignment or study-plan question, and schedule tutoring, writing help or academic coaching through the Welcome Center.
cards.short_summary: A support-centered study destination where students can connect focused work with academic guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel locates the ARC in Cardinal Cushing Library G-04 and lists peer tutoring, study groups, writing help and academic coaching among its services.
cards.access_notes: Appointments use the Emmanuel Welcome Center; the official page lists tutoring hours of Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–8 p.m. and Friday 9 a.m.–4 p.m.

cards.title: Move Into an Eisner Evening Classroom
cards.subtitle: Eight late-evening rooms for quiet or collaborative work
cards.notes: Check the portal’s room-reservation link before heading over, then choose quiet study or group work according to the available room.
cards.short_summary: An after-class option that converts eight Eisner classrooms into designated evening study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel says eight Eisner classrooms are available from 9 p.m. to 2 a.m. for quiet study or collaborative group work.
cards.source_title: Study Spots & Library at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: Officially listed for student study from 9 p.m. to 2 a.m.; consult the portal reservation link for current room availability.

cards.title: Gather a Small Group in Eisner 337
cards.subtitle: A named evening conference room with a two-hour cap
cards.notes: Use this room for a two-to-four-person session after 5 p.m.; confirm availability through Emmanuel’s reservation system first.
cards.short_summary: One specifically identified Eisner conference room available for compact evening group-study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel identifies Conference Room 337 as one of five Eisner rooms available from 5 p.m. to 2 a.m. for groups of two to four, limited to two hours daily.
cards.source_title: Study Spots & Library at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: Available only from 5 p.m. to 2 a.m. for groups of two to four, with a two-hour daily limit; verify current availability before use.

cards.entity_name: Maureen Murphy Wilkens Science Center Atriums
cards.title: Choose a Wilkens Atrium Work Zone
cards.subtitle: Chairs, sofas and tables across all four floors
cards.notes: Walk the four floors to match the setup to your task: use a table for materials or a sofa for reading and review.
cards.short_summary: Four floors of flexible atrium seating support both individual work and informal group sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel says each of the Wilkens Science Center’s four floors has an atrium furnished with chairs, sofas and tables for individual or group study.
cards.source_title: Study Spots & Library at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: The college describes the building as open to all students day and night; campus access requirements still apply.

cards.title: Reserve Wilkens 103 for Group Work
cards.subtitle: A bookable science-center room for two to four students
cards.notes: Book through MySaints up to two weeks ahead and arrive with a clear agenda so the group can use its two-hour allocation well.
cards.short_summary: A reservable ground-floor Wilkens room intended for focused small-group study.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel names Wilkens Room 103 as a group study space bookable up to two weeks ahead for groups of two to four, with a two-hour daily limit.
cards.source_title: Study Spots & Library at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the Student Resources section of MySaints; limited to groups of two to four and two hours per day.

cards.title: Plan a Small-Group Session in Wilkens 113
cards.subtitle: A second reservable option inside the science center
cards.notes: Reserve early through MySaints, invite no more than three partners and structure the work around the room’s two-hour daily limit.
cards.short_summary: A separately identified Wilkens study room that gives small teams another reservable setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel names Wilkens Room 113 as a group study space bookable up to two weeks ahead for groups of two to four, with a two-hour daily limit.
cards.source_title: Study Spots & Library at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the Student Resources section of MySaints; limited to groups of two to four and two hours per day.

cards.title: Work Above the Quad in Yawkey
cards.subtitle: A sunny atrium arranged for reading and group assignments
cards.notes: Bring reading, writing or a collaborative assignment and use the second-floor common seating while keeping active events in mind.
cards.short_summary: An upper-level student-center atrium with Quad views and documented use for collaborative coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel describes the sunny second-floor atrium as overlooking the Quad and serving as a place to collaborate on group assignments.
cards.access_notes: Use while the Jean Yawkey Center is open; the front desk is staffed during building hours, but the source does not publish those hours.

cards.title: Build a Presentation in the McKenna Media Center
cards.subtitle: Flat-panel displays support studying, meetings and presentations
cards.notes: Choose this St. Julie Hall room when your group needs to review visual material, rehearse slides or meet around shared displays.
cards.short_summary: A named all-purpose room whose display equipment suits visual review and presentation practice.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel identifies the Margaret L. McKenna ’83 Media Center as an all-purpose St. Julie Hall room with flat-panel displays for studying, meetings and presentations.
cards.source_title: St. Julie Hall at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: St. Julie Hall is a residence hall; follow residence-hall access rules and confirm room availability with Residence Life.
